notes.title: FULL VERSION – Update V 1.0.0
notes.content:
Helo! Thanks for playing "Who is the Liar?"

In this update we have the full version of the game, improvements and the final part of our dear detective Wadson's investigations!

TIP:
If you have purchased the game in the Early Access version and want to experience the new features from the beginning, do the following:
On the "HOME" screen where is the title "Who`s the Liar?" hit the "F3" button on your keyboard. The game will close automatically. When you start the game, your save point will have been deleted, allowing you to start the game from scratch!


 If you want to continue where you left off, you don't have to do anything, just have fun!


CONTENTS:
 New Case with the end of the story.
 New Minigame.
 New Achievments.

IMPROVEMENTS:

 Gameplay.


 Minigames.


 Texts.


 Puzzles.


 Animations.


We wish you all lots of fun!
Don't forget to leave a comment about the game. It always helps us to improve our work :)

notes.title: - Update V 0.7
notes.content:
Great news! More content and fun. Check it out:

A new Christmas Case for you to unveil.
One more Minigame against the characters of the Madmily mansion.
The Puzzles have been redesigned.
3 new Achievements.
Technical improvements.

Try it out and enjoy some more gameplay while we are baking more content for the full release of the game!
